_comment: Scope for ac_audit.py (delivery/60 R-QA-11). A milestone's criteria are enforced once it is listed in 'started'. 'files' are spec paths (relative to docs/spec, without .md) taken from the 'Exit criteria' column of delivery/62 section 1; 'ids' name individual criteria the plan assigns to the milestone. Criteria in no milestone are reported as unscheduled and do not fail the audit.

build_proven.AC-REL-01: The build produces exactly the modules in delivery/61 section 1 and 'mvnw verify' is green: proven by the CI build job, which fails otherwise.
build_proven.AC-REL-03: maven-enforcer bannedDependencies in model-query-core and model-query-jpa bans org.hibernate* and org.springframework* at compile/runtime scope, transitively; 'mvnw verify' fails on a violation.
